cases: PATCH sends the revision shown in editor
DELETE sends displayed revision and conflict keeps confirmation
missing displayed revision blocks PATCH without network
missing displayed revision blocks DELETE without network
late old PATCH cannot close newer editor
wrong PATCH row acknowledgement preserves draft
same-turn duplicate create blocked and valid ack closes form
lost create acknowledgement cannot manually resubmit; recovery closes draft
remount restores unknown operation and explicit cancellation enables new create
pending save disables all eight form controls
late DELETE preserves a different confirmation
role downgrade disables existing edit and prevents PATCH
actor switch hides prior form and late create acknowledgement
scope: Actual mounted settings TSX, actual creation hook and actor/org guard; synthetic API/session/access provider. Save/recovery/remount/cancellation and role/actor transitions. Parent layout, native UI and production authenticated E2E remain separate checks.
